Aircraft.name: Super Wasp

Switch.State.tooltip: Make wings small... And if you're brave enough: Flying Brick Mode.

Aircraft.Instructions:
Super Wasp By: Shizzle Styx
AG1: Opens Canopy AG2: Emergency Jettison AG3: Deploys Arrestor Hook AG4: Refuel Probe AG5-7: Free AG8: Folds/stows wings
Flaps: Deploys flaps at negative %s Trim: Trims aircraft pitch controls VTOL: Deploys Airbrakes
Notes: With multiplayer being the main theme, I wanted to make 2 naval multirole aircraft that could be flown together to complement each other as opposed to compete with each other (the other one being the Stormvark). I honestly wasn’t sure if I could do the Wasp legacy justice, so I was somewhat hesitant to take it on, but I’m glad I did. Building it was fun, flying it was a lot more fun and I hope you have as much fun as I did flying this plane too!
